description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the DeleteAttributesLiveCommand interface, providing functionality to create, manage, and represent delete attribute commands within a live signaling context in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It defines methods for instantiation, answering, category specification, setting headers, and string representation.

classes.name: DeleteAttributesLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable class implementing DeleteAttributesLiveCommand, representing a delete attributes command in a live signaling context, with methods for creation, header management, and category retrieval.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DeleteAttributesLiveCommandImpl from a given command object, casting it to DeleteAttributes.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Provides a builder to formulate an answer to this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of this command, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified DittoHeaders set.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command changes authorization; returns false.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the instance, including class name and superclass details.
